profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m forever grateful to still be doing what I loved doing as a kid: building things. 

Although my days of building tree houses with friends are in the past, I’m fortunate to now be working with brilliant individuals to solve the needs of our clients by creating scalable, distributed systems.

I'm currently located in Los Angeles, California working at IMAX as a Senior Software Engineer helping to streamline the end to end film process and provide our customers with the IMAX Experience. 

Prior to IMAX, I was with JPMorgan Chase in Seattle, Washington. I was fortunate to have worked on the Chase 2.0 Online Banking website and also help launch a loan originations application as well as a property appraisal application for the Commercial Term Lending division.

I first began my journey as a developer by attending a web development boot camp and was brought on as a teaching assistant shortly after. Having gone through the curriculum myself, I was able to relate to the challenges the students faced and helping them gain the knowledge and confidence needed to be successful in this field was a very rewarding experience. 

Progressing my skills as a developer and sharing my knowledge with others is something I look forward to every day.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer helping to create an ecosystem of applications to streamline the 
content-ordering, production and distribution of IMAX films

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer (2017 - 2018)
• Full stack developer using Angular 5, Java, Spring Boot, Oracle and related technologies creating a property appraisal application following micro-services architecture

Application Developer (2015 - 2017)
• Full stack developer using Ext JS, Java, Spring, Oracle and related technologies to create a loan originations application for the Commercial Term Lending Division
• Design and develop code with emphasis on unit, acceptance and integration testing

UI Developer (2015)
• Developer for the Digital Media Technology Team helping to create the new Chase Online Banking website
• Enhance the desktop, mobile, and tablet experiences for current and prospective customers while supporting all major browsers
• Design and implement reusable components and modules 
• Create web content that meets or exceeds the WCAG 2.0 success criteria

positions.title: Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Support the lead instructor with class lectures and live demos
•	Help facilitate small group discussions
•	Assist students one-on-one and in groups with developing coding skills and code reviews
•	Provide students with feedback on course curriculum and individual projects

positions.title: Business Operations Analyst
positions.description:
•	Received performance recognitions for having the top 5% highest productivity ratings within the department as an employee-in-training and regular employee
•	Finalize, review and deliver research approval documents to clients based on decisions made by the Ethics Board
•	Conduct research to assist the Ethics Board with reviewing and proposing modifications to client research plans
•	Key point of contact to investigate issues or concerns communicated by clients. Coordinate with other departments to resolve client issues and ensure a quick turnaround time for client research proposals
•	Monitor updates to research proposals submitted by clients to meet regulatory requirements and company policies
•	Collect, analyze, and maintain research database to facilitate quicker execution of future research proposals

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed all daily operations spanning multiple functional areas (i.e., sales, inventory, marketing, financial reporting, operations) of a gas station, restaurant & convenient store with annual gross revenue of $5.43 million 
•	Increased the gross revenue of the food business by 27% in seven months through cost saving strategies
•	Responsible for accurate budgets, estimates, forecasts, inventory management, and procurement of all products and services 
•	Created metrics and reporting system to maximize profitability, improve store operations
•	Developed and maintained effective relationships with third party vendors to negotiate contracts, scheduling, pricing, and promotion for merchandise
•	Tracked and analyzed the monthly performance of all departments to ensure best practices were utilized
•	Increased brand awareness and business exposure by increasing involvement within the community 
•	Developed training materials and implemented standardized processes to improve day-to-day operations and customer service
•	Responsible for HR processes including interviewing, hiring, and development of new employees
•	Created weekly schedules and handled the bi-weekly payroll process of 15 employees

positions.title: Marketing/PR Intern
positions.description:
•	Contributed to the success of the company by working closely with the team within different phases of marketing projects
•	Fostered clients’ public image and relations by creating and managing content on different channels of social media 
•	Assisted in creating, planning and organizing promotional events to increase exposure and public interest of clients
•	Prepared, executed and liaised client meetings between English and Non-English speaking individuals
